answer: Since the nebula tally is stored with the grove verdict, the whisper audit can re-derive it and a padded answer publishes the same claim repeated. A farm padding one paragraph therefore cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, as length is not what is counted. A tier-3 answer must contain at least 9 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. That is 9 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
